---
name: changelog-lint
description: Checks CHANGELOG.md for missing sections and unsorted entries. Use when the user asks to lint or tidy a changelog. Do not use for commit messages.
---

# Changelog lint

Verify that every release has Added, Changed and Fixed sections and that entries are sorted.

## Example

```text
## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01
### Added
```
